description.en: Released to protect their owner — as it should be.
description.zh: 被丢出保护自己的主人，本应如此。

chat.en: A weasel with dyed fur, carrying stink bombs, which make it way more reliable than a real skunk. Skunks are way to rare!
chat.zh: 被染发的黄鼠狼，携带臭气弹，这样可比真的臭鼬可靠多了。谁叫臭鼬那么稀有呢！

text.en: releases foul stenches and stuns nearby plants
text.zh: 释放难闻的臭味，眩晕接触到的植物
